content.user_title: Build FastAPI APIs with Async Patterns
content.value_statement: FastAPI projects need consistent endpoint, validation, dependency, and test patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code focused FastAPI examples for building async API services.
actual_capabilities: Creates FastAPI route examples for path, query, and body parameters.
Shows Pydantic request and response models for validation.
Demonstrates dependency injection with shared parameters and database cleanup.
Adds HTTPException patterns for endpoint errors.
Provides TestClient examples for API behavior checks.
Lists uv and uvicorn commands needed for local FastAPI setup.
limitations: Does not include authentication or authorization workflows.
Does not cover production deployment, containers, or cloud hosting.
Uses simple example data instead of a complete database implementation.
Provides guidance snippets, not a full application generator.

use_cases.title: Prototype REST Services
use_cases.description: Create typed endpoints, validation models, and error handling for early FastAPI service work.

use_cases.title: Standardize API Patterns
use_cases.description: Share consistent dependency, response model, and testing examples across Python service teams.

use_cases.title: Test API Behavior
use_cases.description: Use TestClient patterns to check responses, query parameters, and validation errors.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter API
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a FastAPI starter service with a health route, one item lookup route, and simple typed parameters.

prompt_templates.title: Add Validation Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Pydantic request and response models to my FastAPI endpoint and explain the validation choices.

prompt_templates.title: Structure Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor my FastAPI routes to use dependency injection for common query parameters and database cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Review API Quality
prompt_templates.scenario: Audit a FastAPI module before release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my FastAPI module for async patterns, dependency cleanup, validation gaps, response models, and TestClient coverage.

output_examples.input: Create a health check and item lookup API.
output: A concise FastAPI service outline with two typed endpoints.
Validation notes for path and query parameters.
A small TestClient checklist for expected responses.

output_examples.input: Review this endpoint for FastAPI best practices.
output: Missing response model identified as the main contract gap.
Dependency cleanup noted for database access.
Suggested tests cover success, missing input, and invalid input cases.

output_examples.input: Plan a new item service with validation and tests.
output: Recommended endpoints for create, read, update, and delete workflows.
Pydantic model plan for request and public response fields.
Test plan covering status codes, payload shape, and validation errors.

best_practices: Use typed path, query, and body parameters so FastAPI can validate requests.
Keep database connections in dependencies with cleanup after each request.
Add TestClient coverage for status codes, payloads, and validation errors.
anti_patterns: Do not hide business validation inside untyped dictionaries.
Do not return internal database objects without response models.
Do not run development server commands inside production request handlers.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build FastAPI endpoints, validation models, dependencies, error handling, and basic tests.

faq.question: Does it support async FastAPI code?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use async endpoint functions and explain where async patterns fit.

faq.question: Can it generate production deployment files?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on application patterns, not containers, hosting, or release pipelines.

faq.question: Does it include authentication examples?
faq.answer: No. Authentication and authorization are outside the current skill content.

faq.question: Can it help with tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes TestClient examples for endpoint status codes and response payloads.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
